title: Define information and asset handling rules: concept decisions 1
teachingQuestion: Which handling rule permits this action without exposing data beyond its authorized purpose?
focalInsight: Handling compares actor, need, medium, channel, lifecycle state, exception, and evidence.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Handling Requirements
nodes.definition: Rules for access, copy, store, transmit, print, transport, share, and destroy actions.
nodes.detail: Rules for access, copy, store, transmit, print, transport, share, and destroy actions.
nodes.decision: Specify lifecycle touchpoint, roles, approved channel, safeguard, exception, evidence.
nodes.failureExample: Sensitive export uses a personal email because no approved channel exists.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Handling must be usable and enforceable.

nodes.label: Need To Know
nodes.definition: Access limited to information needed for an authorized task beyond general clearance or entitlement.
nodes.detail: Access limited to information needed for an authorized task beyond general clearance or entitlement.
nodes.decision: Check task, purpose, minimum dataset, role, time, and approval.
nodes.failureExample: All project members can read payroll because they have system accounts.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Authorized access still needs a business need.

nodes.label: Media Protection
nodes.definition: Physical and logical safeguards for storage and transport media.
nodes.detail: Physical and logical safeguards for storage and transport media.
nodes.decision: Select protection from medium, sensitivity, location, movement, reuse, and loss exposure.
nodes.failureExample: Unencrypted removable media is transported without custody evidence.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Media protection follows the medium and journey.

nodes.label: Data Minimization
nodes.definition: Collecting and retaining only data and precision needed for stated purpose.
nodes.detail: Collecting and retaining only data and precision needed for stated purpose.
nodes.decision: Challenge each element, recipient, copy, and duration against purpose.
nodes.failureExample: A form collects birth date when age range is sufficient.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Less unnecessary data reduces exposure and burden.

nodes.label: Marking
nodes.definition: Visible label or metadata that communicates handling requirements.
nodes.detail: Visible label or metadata that communicates handling requirements.
nodes.decision: Use consistent markings that systems and people can enforce or recognize.
nodes.failureExample: A sensitive export loses its label and is shared as ordinary material.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Marking supports handling but does not enforce it alone.
